methodological_findings.claim: PRISMA 2020 Item 6 and Item 7 require reporting every database and other information source searched or consulted, the date each was last searched, and the full search strategies including any limits or restrictions.
methodological_findings.implication: The frozen package must document IEEE Xplore, Scopus, OpenAlex, ACM Digital Library (search-only), and Web of Science Core Collection (unavailable) separately with exact search dates and query strings.

methodological_findings.claim: PRISMA 2020 Item 24c requires describing any amendments to information provided at registration or in the protocol.
methodological_findings.implication: Protocol deviations—specifically the unavailability of Web of Science Core Collection, export blockage on ACM Digital Library Basic Edition, and addition of OpenAlex as a supplementary compensatory source—must be formally logged via protocol amendment.

methodological_findings.claim: PRISMA-S Items 1, 7, 13, 15, and 16 require naming each database and platform, describing additional/supplementary sources or methods, reporting search dates, documenting total records identified per source, and describing deduplication processes.
methodological_findings.implication: Observed counts without exported records (ACM 404) and unexecuted sources (WoS Core null, RHN 0) must be kept separate from the 284 importable rows and excluded from deduplication denominators.

methodological_findings.claim: ACM Digital Library Basic Edition provides public open access to ACM-published articles and basic search, but explicitly excludes bulk downloads, saved searches, alerts, and the ACM Guide to Computing Literature, while ACM policies prohibit automated metadata harvesting.
methodological_findings.implication: ACM's 404 observed hits cannot be bulk-exported or scraped into the record corpus under Basic Edition and must remain search-evidence-only unless institutional Premium access is obtained.

methodological_findings.claim: Web of Science Free access and Registered Access without a subscription exclude Document Search, Citing Articles lists, and Citation Reports; searching the Web of Science Core Collection requires an institutional subscription.
methodological_findings.implication: Web of Science Core Collection was not searched (Free View only) and must be reported as unavailable with null counts rather than zero results.

methodological_findings.claim: OpenAlex is a free CC0 open scholarly catalog seeded by Microsoft Academic Graph and aggregated from Crossref, DataCite, PubMed/PMC, DOAJ, arXiv, and repositories rather than a publisher-curated selective citation index.
methodological_findings.implication: OpenAlex's 111 exported rows (102 union IDs) may be frozen as a supplementary compensatory discovery source without claiming equivalence to Web of Science Core Collection.

methodological_findings.claim: Research Horizon Navigator is an AI-native module within InCites Benchmarking & Analytics for discovering emerging research topics via co-citation clustering over the past five years.
methodological_findings.implication: Research Horizon Navigator is not a systematic-review Core Collection search interface, was not executed, and must be excluded from the frozen search dataset.
